source_title: Bose’s new QuietComfort Ultra Headphones hit Prime Day low again
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Bose’s QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) are back down to $369 on Amazon, which saves you $80 off the $449 recommended retail price. That’s an 18% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s worth a look right now because this is a return to the Prime Day price, which is an all-time low.
For anyone shopping for premium noise-canceling headphones, this deal puts one of Bose’s newest models at its best price yet. The QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) are a September 2025 refresh that focuses on improving the parts people care about most instead of changing everything. You’re getting stronger active noise canceling, a lightweight over-ear design, and plush cushioning built for long listening sessions.
On the features side, these headphones support Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC, AAC, and the aptX Adaptive family. There’s also USB-C audio for lossless wired digital listening, which is a nice extra if you want a direct connection. Battery life is rated at about 24 hours with Immersive Audio turned off, and Bose also added smarter adaptive noise control along with better call performance than the earlier model.
The big draw here is still the noise canceling. It’s widely described as class-leading, especially for travel, commuting, and cutting down low-frequency rumble. Add in the balanced, polished sound Bose is known for, and this price drop makes a strong case for buying now while the all-time-low deal is back on Amazon.
